headline_findings.finding: 84.9% of observations inherited a passing baseline, leaving no positive score headroom. Global median treatment effects therefore strongly favor zero or negative classifications.
48 of 49 negative deltas are THINK_TRUNCATED and the remaining one is NO_FINAL_ANSWER. Observed treatment harm is overwhelmingly a completion/token-budget effect, not evidence of incorrect reasoning.
In the controlled dose/representation/placement phase, dose 0.5 produced zero regressions in 432 trials; dose 1.0 produced 9 and dose 2.0 produced 12.
System placement was inert/safest (0 regressions/324), followed by suffix (3), prefix (6), and middle (12).
Schema representation caused 13 regressions in 432 controlled trials versus 4 each for prose and bullets.

ING-011 (tool_argument_validation) was labeled NULL by the global median classifier, yet it rescued 2 of 4 baseline-failing discovery fixtures and caused 0 regressions among 12 baseline-passing fixtures.

The Test-2 priority queue, higher-order candidate queue, and uncertainty ledger are all empty despite 12 positive and 49 negative nonzero observations. Localized signals were lost by aggregation/classification.
Test 1 consumed about 2h48m of active experimental time, not the planned 6h50m, because finite candidate loops exhausted and confirmation had no candidates.
All calibrated family MADs are zero and noise sigma is the 0.05 floor. With binary 0/1 scores, one -1 swing equals -20 sigma and can force HARMFUL classification even when the median delta is zero.

localized_positive_signals.interpretation: Positive evidence is concentrated in coding_generation and context_retrieval; it is promising but not yet independent/generalized.

recommended_harness_corrections: Stratify treatment effects by baseline headroom: rescue rate on baseline failures and regression rate on baseline passes.
Separate completion/truncation outcomes from correctness/capability outcomes.
Use paired Bernoulli/binomial confidence for binary pass/fail scores instead of MAD-normalized median alone.
Treat generation budget as an explicit factor; rerun truncation-sensitive treatments with sufficient budget before calling them harmful.
Promote conditional rescue signals to Test-2 even when global median delta is zero.
Use unused wall-clock budget for replication/generalization of localized signals instead of ending the campaign early.
test2_interpretation_warning: Because the frozen Test-1 handoff queue is empty, any Test-2 fallback recipe selection must not be interpreted as Test-1-discovered optimum. In particular, ING-011 is a missed conditional rescue signal.
